snippet.title: Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Just revealed at NYCC 2025, Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game (working title) is a fast-paced 1v1 fighter where you battle as your favorite characters from the Avatar franchise! Built with proprietary rollback netcode and full cross-play, this hand-drawn 2D fighter is crafted to preserve the style and expressive animation of the original series.

💥 Coming Summer 2026, Rating Pending🎮 PS4, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and Steam!🌟 Wishlist now on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/2424420/
Follow us @Avatar_Fighters for updates:
